title: Offline-First Sync Queue
hints: Queue mutations as enum values; flush them in order whenever you're online.
Before flushing, remove create/delete pairs for the same item.
Rename/delete of a missing server item is dropped and logged.
jsBridge: Offline-first: update local state now, queue mutations durably, and flush in order when online, coalescing where possible. It's the service-worker background-sync pattern in PWAs, done in-app on iOS.
